price_book_title: 2024 DaVinci GreenSmart Electric Price List (USA Pricing)
price_field_note: The price list publishes tiered wholesale columns plus a retail column. For fireplaces (page 2): Level 1 / Level 2 / Level 3 / Level 4 / '50+ Factory' are volume-based dealer/wholesale tiers (deeper discount at higher tiers); a 'SALE' column gives a promotional wholesale price. dealer_price = the Level 1 price (standard wholesale, what Benson pays before volume discounts). msrp = the MSRP column (suggested retail). The Level 2-4, 50+ Factory, and SALE prices are recorded in each model's notes. For accessories (page 3) the columns are 'Cost' (wholesale, mapped to dealer_price) and 'MSRP' (mapped to msrp). All prices FOB origin. Terms 1%/15 Net 30. DaVinci GreenSmart Electric is one configurable unit per size, convertible among single-sided, left corner, right corner, and full bay configurations - the configuration does not change the SKU or price.
